Definition
[Embedded epsilon-neck] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0083, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0084 1. ch18:18.26\group Necks

Let $(\mathcal N^n,h)$ be complete, $R(p)>0$, and $r=c_nR(p)^{-1/2}$. The ball $\mathfrak N=B(p,\varepsilon ^{-1}r)$ is an embedded $\varepsilon $-neck if there is an embedding $\varphi :\mathfrak N\to S^{n-1}\times \mathbb R$, with $\varphi (p)\in S^{n-1}\times \{ 0\} $, such that \[ \left|\varphi ^*(g_{S^{n-1}}+\dd u^2)-r^{-2}h\right|_{C^{\lceil \varepsilon ^{-1}\rceil +1}(r^{-2}h)}<\varepsilon . \] The inverse image of $S^{n-1}\times \{ 0\} $ is its center sphere.
